d:
Dilli aur ensiaar men hava ki gunvatta behad kharab sthiti par hai aur vayu pradushan ke chalte logon ko saf hava nahin mil pa rahi hai. aise men iletroniks market men eyar pyurifayar khub dikhne lage hain. ye eyar pyurifayar hava kaise saf karte hain, saste aur mahange eyar pyurifayar men kya antar hota hai aur eyar pyurifayar lete samay kin baton ka dhyan rakhna chahie? janie is vidiyo ke zarie.
Vidiyoh shubh rana
